001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.registry;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.registry.builtin.itemexpression.ItemExpressionHandler;
004import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
005
006public class PrefixAlreadyRegisteredException extends Exception {
007
008  private final String prefix;
009  private final Plugin plugin;
010  private final ItemExpressionHandler handler;
011
012  public PrefixAlreadyRegisteredException(final String prefix, final Plugin pluginInstance, final ItemExpressionHandler handler) {
013
014    super("The prefix " + prefix + " already in use, registered by " + pluginInstance.getName() + " with handler " + handler.getClass().getName() + ", pick another one prefix!");
015    this.prefix = prefix;
016    this.plugin = pluginInstance;
017    this.handler = handler;
018  }
019
020  public String getPrefix() {
021
022    return prefix;
023  }
024
025  public Plugin getPlugin() {
026
027    return plugin;
028  }
029
030  public ItemExpressionHandler getHandler() {
031
032    return handler;
033  }
034}
